newsitem.title: USA: Bell & Howell files for stock offering.
newsitem.headline: Bell & Howell files for stock offering.

text.p: Bell & Howell Co said Thursday it filed an equity offering with the Securities and Exchange Commission to issue an additional $125 million of common stock.
Representatives of the underwriters in the offering include Donaldson, Lufkin & Jenrette Securities Corp, the lead manager; Bear, Stearns & Co Inc, Salomon Brothers Inc and Smith Barney Inc.

The company said it will use proceeds, along with borrowings under a new revolving credit agreement, in part to purchase all of the outstanding 11-1/2 percent senior discount debentures for a tender price equal to 110 percent of the accreted value.
It also plans to redeem all of the outstanding 10-3/4 percent senior subordinated notes and repay the entire outstanding balance of its existing credit agreement.
